LEAN_PRECIPW_MOIST.why: Column water omits MPAS's division of density by 1+qv.

LEAN_RAD_2025.why: RRTMG uses the 2025 global mean gases and solar constant 1361 W/m2.

LEAN_MYNN_HYD_PS.why: MYNN takes first-layer mass from hydrostatic surface pressure.

LEAN_MYNN_DEW.why: MYNN keeps dew and frost fluxes, bounded to 0.9*qv per step.

LEAN_MYNN_RHOSFC.why: MYNN surface boundary terms use first-layer density.

LEAN_MYNN_MOIST.why: The PBL water conversions keep MYNN's water.

LEAN_SFC_Q2MR.why: Water-cell q2 is a mixing ratio.

LEAN_MYNN_FILL_THL.why: MYNN moisture_check uses a copy of thl so a qc fill heats once.

LEAN_MONO_RELAX.why: The monotonic scalar update also reaches relaxation rows 3-5.

LEAN_NOAHMP_SWSPLIT.why: Noah-MP receives RRTMG's direct/diffuse visible/NIR surface fractions.

LEAN_GF_NOSHALLOW.why: Disable the Grell-Freitas shallow plume; MYNN EDMF carries shallow cumulus.

LEAN_RAD_BLCLOUD.why: MYNN subgrid cloud water and ice reach RRTMG.

LEAN_REFL_CARD.why: The product reflectivity is computed on the card (last-bit differences from the host library).

LEAN_MICRO_ONEKERNEL.why: The card build keeps Thompson's one column kernel beside the stages (LEAN_MICRO_STAGED=1 picks the stages).

LEAN_BUDGET.why: Print global water and energy terms each step on the card path.

LEAN_NOAHMP_T2Z.why: Noah-MP 2 m stability uses the capped L of the flux, for T2 and Q2.

LEAN_NOAHMP_RSF3.why: Noah-MP uses adjusted Sellers ground resistance.

LEAN_NOAHMP_THETA.why: Noah-MP is forced with first-level potential temperature at surface pressure.

LEAN_MYNN_SALT.why: Over the sea MYNN uses 0.98 of fresh-water vapour pressure.

LEAN_GF_DXMIN.why: Disable Grell-Freitas in cells finer than this spacing in metres.
